text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It seems a great many people have<n>turned out to
root for me today.

And that reporter who often writes<n>about me is
among them.
choice_data_list: Go show them the new you!
Go show them the new you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My determination and steadfast<n>progress... I'll
show them all what I<n>can do!

Ready to go, Grass Wonder leaves<n>the waiting
room beaming with<n>energy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe. Let's have a good race today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so glad I ran into you before the<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow... Spe, you're stiff as a<n>board.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Remember, only those recognized and<n>elected by
the fans are able to run in<n>the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Plenty of people have come here to<n>support you
today, so why not take<n>pride in that?
Ha ha... Yeah, I do really appreciate<n>their support.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But, with you and the others here, I<n>feel like I'm so,
so out of my league.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's that time already! We have to<n>go!
Yes. Let's both go out there and give<n>it our all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You can accomplish anything if you<n>put your mind to
it. But you'll<n>accomplish nothing if you don't try.
